g.text: -3.00 m · Partial service loop; four exits, no spawn rooms.
PROPOSED DESIGN · METRE SCALE · NOT YET COLLISION-TESTED OR PLAYTESTED
A service loop under the central blocks and
court. Four stairs connect it to ground and
the gallery system: S2, S3, S6, S7.
A dogleg middle cross-link adds options. No
dead-end spawn room or one-way drop. Warm
exit markers contrast with cool service
Grilles, concrete and metal doors give
clear footsteps. Stealth comes from broken
Headroom, support columns, wall offsets and
actual Rapier traversal must be validated
